script.spoken: Twelve people died that night. A bulk carrier crashed into the piers of Hobart's Tasman Bridge. Two spans fell onto the ship, and it sank. The current had pushed it off course. It struck piers that were never meant to face a ship. In the dark, cars drove into the gap. The city was split in two for years. Ships and traffic were then kept apart whenever vessels passed.
